candidates.desc: In an animated seaside film set, a woman stands behind a big movie camera calling 'rolling' and then 'cut' with crossed arms as a costumed pirate actor overacts on deck. She walks over, demonstrates the movement she wants herself, then happily raises her fists when the take finally works.

A muscular anime villager strains every muscle to push a heavy cart loaded with sacks up a steep cobbled street, sweat flying and feet slipping on wet stones. He collapses onto the handle, then grits his teeth and raises a determined fist to keep going.

On a rooftop at sunset, a small film crew shoots a scene: an actress stands by a light reflector while the director crouches at a camera on a tripod, a boom mic hangs overhead and a clapperboard snaps before the take. Afterwards the whole crew gathers behind the monitor and celebrates the shot.

In a bright startup office, a young woman draws a green leaf-in-hexagon design and proudly shows the finished sheet. She and her colleague peel it as stickers and stick their new company mark on a laptop, coffee cups, shipping boxes and even the sleeping dog's collar.

In an anime-style greenhouse full of white flowers, a woman in a green uniform holds a clipboard and assigns jobs to three workers, pointing one to the crates and one to the watering. She checks her list as they work, then the whole team celebrates a job well done.

In an animated pottery workshop, students struggle as their clay keeps collapsing on the wheels. An old white-bearded master walks in, sits down and shapes a perfect tall vase with slow steady hands, then guides a student's hands until her pot works too, and the students bow to him.

In a 2D cartoon post office, a stern grey-haired woman in uniform with a ring of keys throws open the doors shouting "Open! Everybody in!" and bosses two clerks around. Parcels tumble off the shelves, she points orders while packages are weighed and stamped, the clerks answer "Yes boss!", and she wheels a cart of parcels out the front door.

Inside a busy restaurant, the whole team works together: the chef passes plates over the kitchen counter, waiters carry stacked dishes to tables, a waitress throws a fresh tablecloth and lays cutlery, a barman serves coffee, and at the end the crew poses arm in arm.
A film crew in dark clothes shoots a scene in a bright office: one operator rides a camera dolly, another holds a boom microphone, and big studio lights surround a man sitting at a desk.
An older woman with grey hair stands over a young designer's desk, points at app mockups on his tablet and explains what to change; he looks up at her, nods and gets back to work with his stylus.
A dark-haired woman in a navy suit stands at a wooden podium with a microphone in a packed auditorium, gesturing energetically as she speaks to the seated audience, then folds her hands and smiles.

A man in a blue polo kneels with his toolbox in a bathroom while the desperate homeowner begs him to help; he stares in wide-eyed panic, then wrenches the pipe under the sink until water blasts him in the face and he lands soaked on the floor.

A film shoot in a stone quarry, seen from behind a big cinema camera on a rig in the foreground with its monitor turned towards us. Across the pit stand two tall concrete silos with a metal walkway running from them to the rock face. An orange fireball bursts out at the walkway and black smoke rises; a stuntman hanging on a wire swings away from it across the quarry. The metal walkway tears loose and crashes down the rock face, throwing up a huge cloud of pale dust that fills the pit while the camera keeps rolling and crew in yellow high-visibility vests watch from below.

A hamster in a pink bow spends a day as an office worker. It sits in a big black office chair at a desk covered in papers with a photo ID badge hanging round its neck on a lanyard, yawns hugely and then dozes off. It fills a small white cup at an office coffee machine, sits on a toilet holding a roll of paper under a framed FOCUS FLUSH FINISH sign, then at five o'clock jumps up at the card reader beside the office door with its badge and walks out through the glass door into the sunset.

A young man in a white pilot's shirt with gold striped shoulder boards and a green headset with a boom microphone sits in the cockpit and looks into the camera. The view swings forward through the windscreen: deep blue sky above a flat white deck of cloud stretching to the horizon. The aircraft sinks into the cloud until everything outside is featureless grey, then breaks out low over flat ground. Finally the nose lines up with a grey runway and the centre line and markings rush past underneath.

A tall storage warehouse with long aisles and racking stacked to the roof with wrapped pallets. In the foreground a chihuahua wearing a yellow hard hat and a yellow high-visibility vest stands on its hind legs looking off to the side. Behind it a golden retriever drives an orange forklift carrying pallets of bottled water, while another small dog in a hi-vis vest walks down the aisle. The forklift catches the stack and the pallets of water burst apart, spilling packs of bottles all over the concrete floor. The chihuahua turns to the camera with wide eyes.

A glass-walled office. A woman in a headscarf and a beige blazer leans over a large technical drawing, holding a rule down and marking it with a yellow pencil while two colleagues lean in on either side. She then stands at a table holding a miniature city built in beige card and plastic, with tiny tower blocks, low houses, roads, green lawns and little trees, and reaches in to adjust one of the small towers. Finally she stands outdoors in a yellow hard hat, holding a drawing up in front of a real cluster of tall glass towers.

A glass-walled office tower. A man in a white kandura and headdress shakes hands with someone in the corridor by a glass door, next to a woman holding a takeaway coffee. Inside a meeting room a woman stands at a large screen showing a grid of bag and shoe designs while four people sit round the table with tablets and paper coffee cups. The man in the kandura holds up a tablet and talks the others through it. A close-up shows a hand sketching a design on a tablet with a stylus. At the end the man stands, leans across the table and shakes hands with a seated colleague while the others smile.

An open-plan office. A laptop on a white desk shows a rising stock chart while two people type either side of it. A woman in a light blue shirt walks over with a takeaway coffee, leans across the desk and points at the chart on a man's screen, talking and laughing; he sits back and watches. The whole team then gathers round the desk in a half circle, standing and sitting, and applauds him while he grins at the laptop.

In a bright apartment a woman in a padded gilet with headphones round her neck positions two actors by a window, putting a hand on the man's shoulder to move him. The shot widens to show the film crew at work: two large cameras on tripods, a camera operator in headphones, boom microphones over the actors and studio lights. The woman sits at a monitor watching the take, then punches the air, and the crew clap.

A young man in a mustard jumper with a backpack and an ID card on a lanyard walks in through the glass entrance turnstile of an office building, smiling. In the open-plan office a bearded man carrying files walks up to him and they greet each other with a handshake and a clap on the arm. The young man then sits down at a desk in a long row of desks and works at a computer; other people are typing at desks around and behind him.

Rows of pale baguettes on a wire rack slide out of a glowing bakery oven. Trays of croissants and pains au chocolat are pushed into a shop window while a crowd in winter coats watches from the wet Paris street outside. A man in a shirt and a flour-smeared apron picks up a baguette, holds it to his ear like a telephone, then turns to the camera grinning and holds it up in front of the bakery door.

A laptop on a desk shows lines of green code in a dark editor. A young man in a hoodie clenches his fist and cheers at his screen. He then sits at a two-monitor desk in an open office, typing code with both hands. In a dark room a whole team stands in front of a wall of monitors filled with code. When a huge green check mark appears on the central screen, the whole team throws their arms up and cheers.

In a wooden-floored dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands in front of a class of students in white suits, who all bow together. She then demonstrates for them: she raises one knee and drives a high kick out to the side while the students behind her copy her stance. She holds a wooden board out at arm's length towards the class, calls out an instruction, and finally takes a wide stance with both arms out as the students watch and follow.

A young man in a red and white striped apron and a white cap stands behind the glass display counter of a butcher's shop, filled with trays of steaks, sausages and sliced meat. He holds a thick red steak up in front of a brass weighing scale and lays it on the tray. He folds brown paper around the meat on the white block, ties the parcel with red and white string, and hands it across the counter with a smile.

A street tea stall hung with orange marigold garlands: a vendor in an orange kurta lifts a steel pan high above his head and pours a long unbroken stream of milky tea down into a jug at waist height without spilling a drop, repeating the trick while a tight semicircle of young men film him, laugh and applaud; he then fills small steel cups and hands them round.

On a seaside promenade lined with palm trees an older woman with a grey plait, knee pads and elbow pads rolls along on a skateboard, laughing. A jogger passes her, then a man in a dark coat hops onto a board behind her and copies her, and finally a man in a business suit carrying a black briefcase in one hand steps onto a skateboard as well. All of them roll down the promenade together past the benches and the sea, grinning.

In a glass-walled meeting room high above the city a woman in a black suit stands at a whiteboard covered in coloured sticky notes and talks her colleagues through her work while they sit around a table full of laptops. One after another they cut in: a man raises a finger, others lean forward and talk over her, and she raises her voice to keep going. Then a young man walks in behind her with a tray of takeaway coffees, the whole table turns to the coffee, and she leans on the table looking defeated.

A hotel housekeeper in a turquoise uniform with a pink-trimmed apron snaps a white sheet out over a bed and lets it settle, plumps and squares up the pillows, then folds two towels into a swan and tucks a pink frangipani flower against its neck. She steps back smiling, then goes back to her trolley of stacked towels and toiletries in the doorway.

A montage of people falling asleep where they should be awake: a young man at a computer in an open-plan office yawns hugely, then drops face down onto his keyboard; a student in a grey hoodie and glasses sleeps on an open book in a library; a man in a jacket sits slumped back on a park bench in bright sunshine with his head tipped back, asleep; a man in a grey tracksuit sprawls yawning on a sofa beside a coffee table holding a twin-bell alarm clock and a phone.

A large warehouse aisle with tall steel racking on both sides, full of shrink-wrapped pallets. A woman in a hi-vis vest and work gloves lifts cardboard boxes onto a wooden pallet beside a conveyor, building the load up layer by layer until it is chest high and wrapped in clear plastic film. She then takes the handle of an orange pallet truck, pumps it, and pulls the finished pallet away down the aisle past the racking, a forklift moving in the background.

A sunny city street lined with brownstone buildings and black fire escapes. A young man dressed in a huge hot-dog costume, with a bun, a sausage and a yellow mustard stripe, jogs on the spot grinning and points a big foam pointing hand towards a steel food cart. At the cart a young man in a blue shirt and beige trousers laughs as a young woman in a burgundy jacket hands him a hot dog, and he takes it. Long shadows fall across the pavement.

A view through an open door into a corner office high above a city at dusk, with floor-to-ceiling windows showing skyscrapers and the sea. A young man in a white shirt and navy tie leans back in a big black leather chair with his shoes up on the wooden desk next to a globe, grinning confidently as he tugs his tie, then puts both hands behind his head and relaxes. An amber glass lamp hangs above, an abstract painting is on the wall, and a tray with two coffee cups sits on the rust carpet.

In a busy bakery café with loaves of bread on wooden shelves, a chalkboard menu and a glowing glass lamp, a young woman with long braids, in a cream jumper and black skirt, smiles as she slides a black folder across a wooden table to a young man in a white shirt and navy apron. He opens another folder and reads it closely while she waits with her hands in her lap. Two cups of coffee and croissants sit between them. Behind the counter a young baker kneads dough.

In a modern meeting room with a living wall of ferns and a big window over city skyscrapers, a young woman with wavy strawberry-blonde hair, in a navy blazer, white top and cream skirt, stands at the end of a long wooden table holding a presentation clicker and smiling. Her colleagues react warmly: a man in a light blue shirt throws both hands up, a man in a white shirt claps, and a woman in a cream suit claps, then stands up and keeps clapping towards her. Notebooks and glasses of water lie on the table.

Inside a new building made of raw concrete, with tall curved arches and a round skylight that throws a circle of sunlight onto the smooth grey floor, a young woman in a white hard hat, an orange high-visibility vest, a blue top and cream trousers holds up a large drawing of a curved arch and compares it with the real one, smiling. She walks slowly forward, looking up. A worker in a yellow vest and hard hat kneels by the wall with a long spirit level and looks up at her. Trees with purple blossom show through an opening.

In a busy restaurant kitchen with white tiles, copper pans hanging above the stove, brass lamps and a red and cream checked floor, a young woman head chef in a white jacket and burgundy neckerchief raises one hand and calls out, her other hand on a plate at the pass. A long row of plates of roast chicken and green beans waits in front of her. Two cooks in navy aprons work at the stove behind her, and then a young cook in a navy apron steps in and sets down another plate beside her.

In an old seaside dance hall with tall arched windows and string lights across the ceiling, a man in a cream linen suit and tie shakes hands with a young woman with curly hair in a green satin top and black wide trousers, holding up two fingers with his other hand; both smile. Then she lets go, turns and walks happily toward the stage, waving him along. Behind them musicians set up: a woman with a double bass and another woman with a drum. A roller door stands open onto a boardwalk.

In a work yard at dusk, a young woman in a tan work jacket and trousers, her braided hair in a bun, places her hand gently on the arm of a young man in a dark zip jumper who holds an empty wooden crate. She speaks to him seriously, lifts a white paper and shows it to him, and he turns from her face to the paper with a shocked look. Workers in yellow high-visibility vests stand near metal sheds, a street lamp glows and the sky is deep blue.

A young man with black hair, in a rust-red jumper and big headphones, sits in a small wood-panelled radio studio at dusk. He smiles, talks into a silver microphone on a studio arm and moves the sliders of a large mixing desk with one hand. Then he leans back from the desk and lifts a hand to his headphones. A red light glows above the door, vinyl records and a glass of water stand beside him, and a red and white radio mast rises outside the window.

In a busy old-fashioned office with tall windows, wooden desks, typewriters, rotary phones and an old computer, a young man in a light blue shirt, tie and grey trousers rolls along the wooden floor on red roller skates, carrying a tall stack of ring binders. He sways and kicks one skate out as he moves, and a loose sheet falls to the floor. Colleagues at every desk wave folders and documents at him, calling for his attention, and an open filing cabinet drawer stands beside him.

In a bright modern office high above a city, a young man in glasses and a light blue shirt draws a curved line with a marker across a glass wall covered in printed charts, graphs and sticky notes. Then he steps back with a pile of printouts and looks at the room, while two young women behind him point their pens at the charts and stare at the curve. Laptops, coffee cups, a highlighter and scattered chart printouts cover the long white desk.

At a cosy kitchen table at night by a window with fairy lights and a city view, a young woman with her hair in a messy bun, flour on her face and a cream jumper eats a big bite of cake from a fork while typing on a laptop with a colourful web page open. Then she lowers the fork and turns to look to the side. In front of her stand three plates of home-made cakes, each with a yellow sticky note, plus mugs and a bowl. A tabby cat watches from the windowsill.

In a bright corridor used as a waiting area, a young woman in a black blazer and white top, with sunglasses on her head, leans out of an open office door holding papers and a pen, beckons with one finger and speaks. Along the wall people in mascot costumes wait on chairs: a smiling sun and a chicken. A young man in a full banana suit walks past her through the door into the office, and she steps back to let him in. A coat stand with costume heads and a water cooler stand at the end of the corridor.

On top of a huge offshore wind turbine far out at sea on a bright day, a laughing young woman with a long braid, orange work trousers, a grey top and a yellow safety harness sits on the white roof holding a metal flask and a mug of steaming coffee. A colleague in a white helmet eats a croissant beside her and points, and a seagull flies past the turbine blades. A lunch box with croissants and apples, flasks, helmets, gloves and a coiled rope lie around them, and a boat crosses the sea below.

On the deck of a fishing boat at sea under a cloudy sunset sky, a huge green net full of silver fish rises from over the side, pouring fish onto the wet deck. A young woman in a knitted hat and orange waterproof overalls leans on a rope winch and shouts with joy. The crane lifts the bulging net high above the deck while crew members in orange gear cheer with raised arms by the white wheelhouse, and seagulls circle overhead.

In a small basement comedy club with pipes on the ceiling, fairy lights and a single spotlight, a young man in a brown corduroy jacket and jeans stands on a low black stage next to a microphone stand with a calm, straight face. In front of him the audience roars with laughter: people bend over in their seats, one man lies on the floor, a chair tips over and falls, and spilled beer lies on the wooden boards. The view moves closer to the man, who stays serious.

In a modern open-plan office with standing desks, bean bags, sticky notes on glass and an indoor slide, a young man with a moustache, round glasses, a tweed waistcoat and a tie sits at an old wooden desk with a typewriter, two rotary telephones, a green banker's lamp and stacks of files. He holds up his hands to refuse, then lowers them and starts typing on the typewriter. A young woman in colourful overalls stands behind him and puts a hand to her head.

In a busy restaurant kitchen with steel counters and steam, a young man in a beige linen suit and suede loafers stands on top of a steel counter and draws a flowchart with boxes and arrows on a large paper flip chart with a marker. He then writes on a clipboard. Cooks in white jackets watch him, a head chef in black folds his arms and looks doubtful, and a pan bursts into tall flames behind. Plates of food, spilled sauce and a ladle sit on the counter.

Backstage at an outdoor music festival at dusk, under strings of bulbs, a young woman with long braids, a black bomber jacket, a headset microphone and a pass on a lanyard stands in the middle, pointing with one hand and signalling with the other to direct the crew. A man works on a ladder, men move black flight cases and a caterer stands nearby. She then lowers her arms and stands still. The lit stage tent glows with coloured lights behind.

Inside a television broadcast truck, a young man with his hair in a bun, a black T-shirt and a headset with a microphone laughs as he points at a small screen and presses buttons on a big lit-up mixing desk. A wall of monitors shows tennis matches, and the biggest screen shows a shaggy dog in sunglasses with a tennis ball in its mouth. Beside him a red-haired woman covers her mouth, then bends over laughing. A paper coffee cup sits on the desk.

In a dim film editing room, a young woman with dark hair in a messy bun and a black hoodie sits at a desk with her hand on a colourful editing keyboard. A side monitor shows a swimmer in a tropical lagoon, and the big dark screen on the wall switches to a snowy mountain slope. She folds her arms and looks at it, then puts her hands back on the keyboard. A young man in a beanie on a leather sofa laughs and points. Film posters, a lava lamp, headphones and a coffee cup fill the room.

A crowded antiques warehouse with high wooden beams. A young woman in a tweed jacket and tall boots stands on an old armchair balanced on a suitcase on top of a wooden wardrobe, holding a crystal chandelier that throws sparks at its fitting and reaching out with her other hand, then smiles down. A young man in dungarees steadies the wardrobe and a man in a camel coat looks up and spreads his hands. Grandfather clocks, rolled rugs, lamps and stuffed birds under glass domes fill the room, and pigeons fly under the roof.

A building site under a blue sky with big white clouds. A young woman in a cream trouser suit, a black top, sunglasses and white trainers stands in the bucket of a yellow excavator as it slowly lowers her towards the ground, holding a small white model house on a board high in one hand and pointing into the distance with the other. Below, workers in hard hats and yellow safety vests stand by a site office cabin, a bulldozer waits, and plots of bare earth are marked out with stakes and orange tape.

In a small new cafe in a brick-walled garage on a rainy morning, a young woman in a denim shirt, patterned scarf and grey apron pushes the metal roller shutter all the way up with one hand, holding a spatula in the other, and stares out in surprise at a long queue of people with umbrellas on the wet pavement. She turns towards the steaming pan on the gas stove, looks back with an excited smile, then turns to the stove again and raises a hand. Wooden stools, a counter, paint tins and a ladder fill the room.

In a sunny farmyard, a smiling young woman in a navy postal polo shirt, shorts, boots and sporty sunglasses holds out a bundle of letters by a wooden gate and then walks down the track towards the camera with the letters in her hand. A group of grey geese walks closely all around her, some flapping their wings, and a black and white collie trots behind. Two farm workers in overalls by a quad bike laugh and wipe their eyes, and a cat sits on the stone wall.

At night in heavy snow, an old red-brick fire station with three arched garage doors stands open and brightly lit, showing red fire engines inside. Through a tall lit window upstairs a firefighter slides down a brass pole. A fire engine with flashing red lights drives out of the middle door, crosses the snowy forecourt and turns onto the road. Firefighters in yellow gear stand by the doors, and a bell hangs in the tower above. Tyre tracks cross the snow in front.

On the deck of a small fishing boat in a stormy sea, a young woman with braids, a navy jumper and orange waterproof bib trousers shouts with effort as she hauls a huge green net full of silver fish over the rusty rail. The fish pour out of the net and spill across the wet wooden deck around her boots. Seagulls fly overhead, a big wave breaks white behind the boat, and a man in yellow oilskins laughs by the winch. Plastic crates of fish stand nearby, and an island lies in the distance.

A young woman in a navy vest and work trousers throws her arms up and shouts with joy inside a sheep-shearing shed with a corrugated metal roof and wooden pens, as clumps of wool fly into the air. A freshly shorn white sheep trots away. She grabs a big armful of wool, drops to her knees and hugs it, laughing. Tired young men in vests sit slumped against the wall, an older man in a navy shirt sweeps with a broom, and a huge pile of fleeces lies at the back of the shed.

A young woman with braided hair in a cream blazer, black trousers and heels sits on a grey bench in a bright modern office waiting area with glass walls and a view over city rooftops. Holding a paper coffee cup, she bends to pick up papers that have slipped out of her folder onto the floor. She stands up smiling with the papers and coffee and walks towards a woman with a clipboard waiting by the door, leaving the folder on the floor. Two young men in suits sit on the bench, and a receptionist sits behind a white desk.

In a small bedroom of a house at a zoo on a foggy morning, a young woman with curly hair pinned up, in blue striped pyjamas, brushes her teeth at the open window while a giraffe pokes its head in and licks her toothbrush with its long dark tongue. Then she steps back with the toothbrush in her hand and the giraffe lifts its head away, and she looks out of the window. Her zoo uniform shirt hangs on the wardrobe with a cat on top, boots stand by the bed, a hen walks on the floor and more giraffes stand outside.

In a bright bicycle factory with tall windows, a young woman in a navy cap, grey T-shirt, work apron and gloves steadies the wheel of a bicycle hanging from an overhead assembly line, then works on it with a cordless drill and finally turns to the steel workbench in front of her. On the bench lie trays of bolts, a bike chain, a stack of black tyres and a brown saddle. Other workers work at benches behind her and rows of finished bicycles stand in a rack on the right.

On the high outer bridge of a cargo ship in a container port at dusk, a young woman officer with a blonde braid, in a navy uniform, leans over the rail pointing down and speaking into a walkie-talkie as she guides a red tugboat below. Behind her an older bearded captain in a white peaked cap watches calmly. Crew members in overalls handle ropes on the deck, a thermos flask and binoculars sit on the ledge, and cranes and stacked containers line the quay.

On a busy city street between glass skyscrapers, a young woman bike courier in a sticker-covered helmet, a dark T-shirt, jeans and a messenger bag stops on her bicycle and hands a yellow envelope to a young man in a grey suit by a revolving door. He takes it and walks into the building, while she rides off along the pavement towards the viewer. A yellow taxi passes, steam rises from a street grate, pigeons peck on the pavement and office workers walk by.

A tall old stone mill building stands beside a river in evening light, with a big wooden waterwheel turning under rushing white water at its base. A young red-haired woman swings out from an upper doorway on a rope, sitting on a sack and laughing, and swings down over the waterwheel, while a cloud of white flour bursts from the loft door above her. Two men lean out of the doorway reaching towards her, a horse and cart stand on the left and birds fly over the roof.

Inside an old windmill lit by oil lanterns, a young woman covered in white flour dust, in work clothes and boots, hangs from a thick rope above a wooden case holding two large round millstones and slides down it to the stone floor. A huge wooden cogwheel sits under the roof beams. A young man climbs a ladder and a woman at a shutter looks on, flour pours from a wooden chute into a sack, and full sacks stand on the floor.

A busy restaurant kitchen with white tiled walls and copper pans. A young man in a white T-shirt and grey trousers climbs a black iron spiral staircase and reaches up for a white chef's jacket that an older chef holds out to him from the gallery above. Cooks in white jackets and aprons cheer and push him upwards from below, and more cooks on the balcony throw tea towels into the air and clap. Steam rises from large steel pots on the stove.

A work meeting in a bright office with brick walls and tall windows. A young woman in a bright blue blazer and cream trousers stands at the head of a long wooden table, raises a pen and smiles, then sits down and draws on large building plans unrolled on the table. A young man in a denim shirt and a young woman in a lilac cardigan lean over the plans with her. Open notebooks, paper cups and a glass water jug stand around them under black wire pendant lamps.

An office with bare concrete walls. A large round wall clock shows both hands straight up at twelve. A young woman in black dives through a service hatch under a half-raised metal shutter, stretched flat in the air, and slaps a thick blue bound report down on the desk as loose pages fly off. She lands with her hands on the desk and smiles. A young man in a light blue shirt at the desk was drinking from a glass and now throws up his hands in surprise, while two colleagues behind the hatch stare in amazement.

A large, empty open-plan office in an old brick building late at night, dark outside the tall windows. Every desk is empty except one, where a young woman in a cream blouse sits alone, writing on papers, surrounded by piles of documents, sticky notes, a mug and a takeaway box; her jacket hangs on the chair. She keeps working, then rests her head on her hand and rubs her temple, tired. Far in the background a cleaner with a trolley and a security guard stand by the lit exit.
